description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class implements a model for employment status data used in the API layer, utilizing traits and interfaces for serialization and normalization. It primarily wraps an EmploymentStatus entity and specifies which properties ('id' and 'name') are exposed or filterable.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusModel
classes.description: A model class representing employment status data for the API, implementing normalization and serialization behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the EmploymentStatusModel by associating it with an EmploymentStatus entity and setting filterable properties.
